next.reason: 1985: "The number of digit positions that can be represented in the PICTURE character-string must range from 1 to 18 inclusive"; 2023: "for fixed-point data items of category numeric-edited, the number of digit positions ... shall range from 1 through 31.". Both define the pictures that make an item numeric-edited, but the digit limit rose from 18 to 31, so 19-31 digit edited pictures are now accepted. 2023 also adds floating-point edited items.
